name: Can I replace only the glass, or do I need a whole new window?

mainEntity.name: Can I replace only the glass, or do I need a whole new window?

acceptedAnswer.text: In many cases, you can replace just the insulated glass unit (IGU) without replacing the entire window frame. This is a common and cost-effective solution when the window frame itself is still in good condition, structurally sound, and free from rot or significant damage. If the frame is compromised or you're looking for a different style or material, a full window replacement might be more appropriate. We assess the condition of your existing frames to recommend the best approach.
acceptedAnswer.description: Often, you can replace just the glass unit if the window frame is in good condition; a full window replacement is for damaged frames or style changes.
